measurement_scope: Five groups of twenty fixed-input denoiser calls per mode; one warm full-budget sample repeat per stage with RNG restored. No torch.profiler. Model and conditioning resident; not whole-pipeline multi-ligand throughput.
limitations: One protein-ligand input and one paired job; no general accuracy or throughput claim.
Graph conditions and tensor shapes are fixed within a sample; no cross-ligand graph reuse implemented.
Experiment CLI includes microbenchmarks and repeated sampling; CLI wall time is not deployment latency.
Final structure comparison uses serialized CIF coordinates, not full-precision internal coordinates.
decision: Prioritize structure-stage graph replay; affinity-stage benefit is small in this input. Next measure independent end-to-end runs without embedded benchmarks and with per-sample graph lifecycle.
